questions.ask: Could you please tell me your date of birth?
And what are the last four digits of the phone number we have on file?

hints.day_month_swapped: Thank you. Could you please say the month of your birth as a word?

lines.opening: Hello, this is Freya Bank's digital assistant calling from Freya Bank. Please note that we record this call.
lines.robot: I am Freya Bank's digital assistant.
lines.scam: You can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number.
lines.purpose_before_verify: I can only discuss the reason for my call with the account holder.
lines.no_info: I'm sorry, I don't have that information.
lines.not_talk_once: I understand. This will only take a moment.
lines.tp_ask: When would be a good time to reach them?
lines.tp_ask_time: What time would suit, between 10 in the morning and 7 in the evening?
lines.tp_outside_window: I'm sorry, I can only arrange a call today or on the next business day, between 10 in the morning and 7 in the evening. Is there another time that works?
lines.tp_no_info: I'm sorry, I can only speak with the account holder.
lines.tp_booked: Thank you, we will call back on {date} at {time}.
lines.condolence: I am sorry for your loss.
lines.id_intro: Before we continue, I need to ask you two security questions.
lines.id_explain: I understand. These questions protect your account, and I need them before I can continue.
lines.id_declined: I understand. Without the security check I can't continue.
lines.id_wrong: I'm sorry, that doesn't match our records.
lines.id_failed: I'm sorry, I couldn't verify your identity. Please use the Freya Bank mobile app or visit a branch.
lines.disclose_intro: Thank you, you're verified. I'm calling from the collections team about a late payment.
lines.product_line: Your {name} has {amount} past due, {days} days late.
lines.ask_today: Can you make this payment today?
lines.ask_today_multi: Can you pay all of them today?
lines.offer_floor_date: I understand. Could you pay the minimum of {amount} on {date}? The rest stays overdue.
lines.offer_floor: I understand. I can accept the minimum of {amount}; the rest stays overdue.
lines.below_floor: I'm sorry, I can't record less than {amount}. Could you pay {amount}? The rest stays overdue.
lines.date_past: That date has passed. Which day from today can you pay?
lines.not_business_day: That day is not a business day. The next business day is {date}. Can you pay then?
lines.after_deadline: The latest date I can record is {date}. Can you pay by then?
lines.vague_ask: Which exact day can you pay?
lines.ask_date_for_amount: On which day can you pay {amount}?
lines.clamped_note: That is the latest date I can record for this one.
lines.sms_line: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.
lines.record_failed: I'm sorry, I could not record the promise.
lines.paid_line: Thank you. Payments can take one business day to appear.
lines.dispute_line: I understand. I have noted that you dispute this.
lines.hardship: I'm sorry to hear that. Would you like me to connect you with our customer support team?
lines.restructure_line: I'll transfer you to our restructuring team.
lines.human_ask_help: I can help you with this. Is there something I can do for you first?
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
lines.id_format_hint: Could you say it as day, month and year, for example the first of May nineteen eighty?
